scope: Exact delivered GLB reimport renders at native dimensions. All 21 full-resolution renders, four boards and three locked source copies directly inspected for identity, ratios, topology, every elevation, openings, optics, construction contacts, program, circulation, landscape, cameras and regressions. This is a complete new review, not contact closure alone.

findings.finding: Planted strips, cafe seating and furnishings establish the intended program but remain schematic. Source trees, grasses, stone texture and detailed interior finishes are outside this architectural-clay profile.

Phone comparisons pair appropriate frontal, oblique and roof-bearing views. Model crops are smaller than source crops and camera registration remains approximate. Tightening framing would improve presentation; complete full-resolution evidence makes the relevant geometry inspectable.

previous_findings.closure: End-column and head faces now meet the side carrier cleanly. Tall gray strips and cap patches are absent in both side elevations, side_projection and roof_contact.

previous_findings.category: redundant fascia overlaps head and slab
previous_findings.closure: The redundant fascia is removed. Front bands and side ends now read as uniform seated construction, without rectangular tone patches or duplicate layers. Ground-level slab and carrier junction also reads cleanly.
Roof and perimeter extend across the complete front-frame envelope. The former top-corner notch is absent; membrane and coping form a continuous closed perimeter.

previous_findings.category: earlier roof membrane band and coping overlap
previous_findings.closure: Fresh roof views show no mottled band, doubled coping corner or exposed gray slab stripe.

previous_findings.category: middle landing guard blocks upper stair
previous_findings.closure: Both stair views show clear continuous flights; upper landing connects to the corridor. Exact-model 57-sample audit reports no support or 1.85m headroom failure.
Paired glazed leaves, central division and transom remain present; the open leaf provides a visible public entrance.

previous_findings.status: remains closed with P2 presentation residual
previous_findings.closure: Glass close shows actual glazing and furnished interior. Comparison angles show the relevant facade, terraces and roof; approximate registration is recorded as nonblocking polish.

holistic_checks.source_identity_and_ratios: Three occupied floors with a tall active lobby below two six-bay guest floors. Source-led height, stepped 24m/22.4m/21m widths and frame rhythm remain coherent with the exact references.
holistic_checks.roof_and_terraces: Single complete top roof covers the upper loggia to its outer column/head frame. Glazing remains recessed behind that frame. Both planted terraces have continuous walking strips and seated edge/return guards. No roof, soffit or envelope gap is visible.
holistic_checks.all_elevations_and_openings: Three side-window columns, complete inferred rear, rear service entry, recessed windows, guest terrace exits, paired public entrance and consistent front counts remain legible. Carrier apertures are visible through to occupied rooms.
holistic_checks.contacts_and_load_paths: Front bands, loggia columns/heads, side corners, roof perimeter, vent curbs, canopy, ground plinth and planting bases are seated and visually coherent. Corrected intersections show no remaining visible P0/P1 defect.
holistic_checks.program_and_circulation: Lobby reception/lounge, cafe frontage, guest rooms, bathroom, both stair flights, corridor and landings are represented. Dedicated program views and matching-model offline samples support the prescribed routes within the stated evidence limits.
holistic_checks.materials_and_optics: Pale stone carrier, dark frames/guards, warm soffit and transparent recessed glazing preserve source material zoning in clay. Rooms have depth and visible furniture. No textured realism claim.
holistic_checks.landscape_and_visibility: Planted terrace strips, front garden and cafe seating are grounded. Every mandatory view shows its intended subject; contact and phone boards consistently identify the exact v005 candidate.
holistic_checks.regressions: Fresh complete review found no new P0/P1 after the final contact corrections. Earlier v003 failed review and v004 scoped diagnostic remain preserved as historical records.

route_evidence.scope: Family-specific prescribed centrelines, floor support and 1.85m vertical clearance only.

limitations: Runtime placement, walking, collision, persistence and catalogue activation are NOT_TESTED.
Offline ray probes do not establish continuous body collision or building-code compliance.
Approval is architectural clay at the exact delivered native dimensions only. No textured keeper, runtime catalogue or arbitrary-scaling approval.
